title: TF Syntax Basics - Part Three - Model Evaluation

cues.en: (gentle music)
cues.zh: （輕柔音樂）

cues.en: Instructor: Welcome back, everyone.
cues.zh: 講師：各位，歡迎回來。

cues.en: In part three of the Keras Syntax Basics, we're gonna focus on the evaluation of our model.
cues.zh: Keras 語法基礎第三部分要著重評估模型。

cues.en: Recall, that we have this test set that we can compare our model's predictions to to evaluate how well our model is actually performing.
cues.zh: 還記得我們有測試集，可以把模型預測和它比較，評估模型實際表現。

cues.en: Let's head back to the notebook and continue where we left off.
cues.zh: 回到筆記本，接續上次的進度。

cues.en: Okay, here we are where we left off last time.
cues.zh: 好，這就是上次停下來的地方。

cues.en: Now with this plot, I can see my losses on the training set, but what I really wanna know is how well will this model perform on data that it's never seen before,
cues.zh: 這張圖能看出訓練集上的損失，但我真正想知道的是模型對從未見過的資料表現如何，

cues.en: and that data is our test data.
cues.zh: 而那些資料就是測試資料。

cues.en: There's lots of different ways we can evaluate.
cues.zh: 評估的方式有很多。

cues.en: So we're gonna walk through a bunch of different methods and a lot of these will return back the same result, some mean squared error.
cues.zh: 我們會介紹幾種方法，其中許多會傳回相同結果，也就是均方誤差。

cues.en: So we're just gonna go through the various methods of doing this.
cues.zh: 所以我們來看看各種做法。

cues.en: One way to do this is by calling model.evaluate.
cues.zh: 其中一種是呼叫 model.evaluate。

cues.en: And the way model.evaluate works is you pass in your test set, x and y.
cues.zh: model.evaluate 的用法是傳入測試集的 x 和 y。

cues.en: So what I'm going to say is, X_test and y_test.
cues.zh: 所以這裡傳入 X_test 和 y_test。

cues.en: And I will say verbose is equal to zero, so I don't see a bunch of output.
cues.zh: 我把 verbose 設成零，避免顯示一大堆輸出。

cues.en: And if I run this, what happens is it returns back your model's loss on the test set in y_test.
cues.zh: 執行後，它會傳回模型在測試集 y_test 上的損失。

cues.en: So what this number actually represents is the metric loss that you decided on.
cues.zh: 這個數值代表你選定的損失指標。

cues.en: And if we take a look back at our model, in our case, that's mean squared error.
cues.zh: 回頭看我們的模型，這裡使用的是均方誤差。

cues.en: So what this means is on the test set that is data it's never seen before, it's getting back a mean squared error of 24.97.
cues.zh: 也就是說，對於從未見過的測試集，模型的均方誤差為 24.97。

cues.en: So we could do the same thing for our training set.
cues.zh: 訓練集也可以這樣做。

cues.en: So we could say, model.evaluate X_train versus y_train,
cues.zh: 可以呼叫 model.evaluate，比較 X_train 和 y_train，

cues.en: run that, and we see the loss on our training set.
cues.zh: 執行後就會看到訓練集上的損失。

cues.en: Keep in mind your values may look slightly different just because of the way the neural network works.
cues.zh: 請記得，由於神經網路的運作方式，你得到的數值可能略有不同。

cues.en: It starts off with random initializations, so you may get numbers that are slightly different.
cues.zh: 它一開始會隨機初始化，所以數字可能有些差異。

cues.en: However, after training on about 250 epochs, you should be hovering somewhere between 24 and 26 as your mean squared error.
cues.zh: 不過，訓練約 250 個 epoch 後，均方誤差應該落在 24 到 26 左右。

cues.en: So what does this actually mean?
cues.zh: 這到底代表什麼？

cues.en: Well, this is a way we can interpret our results to see how well the predictions are actually performing.
cues.zh: 我們可以藉此解讀結果，了解預測表現如何。

cues.en: And we'll show you how to also grab root mean squared error and mean absolute error.
cues.zh: 我也會示範如何取得均方根誤差和平均絕對誤差。

cues.en: So the way we can do that is get our actual true predictions.
cues.zh: 為了做到這點，我們先取得實際的預測值。

cues.en: And we do that by saying model.predict, and we're gonna pass in our test to get test_predictions.
cues.zh: 呼叫 model.predict，傳入測試資料，得到 test_predictions。

cues.en: So what this does is we pass in our test features and have the model predict just based off those features what it thinks the price should be.
cues.zh: 也就是傳入測試特徵，讓模型僅依據這些特徵預測價格。

cues.en: So now here's a list of the prices that are predicted based off our X_test set.
cues.zh: 這裡就是根據 X_test 預測出的價格清單。

cues.en: And in fact, let's bring these together along with the true values for that test set, that is the y_test, and then we can plot them out and compare them against each other.
cues.zh: 我們把它和測試集的真實值，也就是 y_test 放在一起，再畫圖比較。

cues.en: So what I'll do is the following.
cues.zh: 我會這樣做。

cues.en: I will create a data frame called pred_df, so my prediction data frame, and it's going to be equal to, and in this case I will say,
cues.zh: 建立名為 pred_df 的 DataFrame，也就是預測資料框，讓它等於……這裡先設定，

cues.en: that my test predictions are this model.predict and I will turn those into a Panda series by saying
cues.zh: 測試預測值來自 model.predict，並用以下方式轉成 pandas Series：

cues.en: test predictions is equal to pd.series, test_predictions.
cues.zh: test_predictions 等於 pd.Series(test_predictions)。

cues.en: And in this case, I will need to reshape this to be 300, comma.
cues.zh: 這裡需要先把形狀改成 (300,)。

cues.en: And that's just so it matches up with the dimensions that a Pandas series call expects.
cues.zh: 這是為了符合 pandas Series 呼叫所預期的維度。

cues.en: So essentially after running this, I still have those same test predictions, but it's a Pandas series now instead of a NumPy array,
cues.zh: 執行後仍是同一批測試預測值，只是從 NumPy 陣列變成 pandas Series，

cues.en: which will allow me to do the following.
cues.zh: 這樣就能做接下來的事。

cues.en: I can say my prediction data frame is equal to pd.DataFrame
cues.zh: 讓預測資料框等於 pd.DataFrame，

cues.en: based off y_test.
cues.zh: 資料使用 y_test。

cues.en: I'm gonna say the columns here are just Test True Y.
cues.zh: 欄名設定為 Test True Y。

cues.en: So right now my prediction DataFrame just has the true value of Y.
cues.zh: 目前預測 DataFrame 只有 Y 的真實值。

cues.en: And what I'm going to do is say go ahead and concatenate that
cues.zh: 接著把它串接起來，

cues.en: with the true value of Y, comma, with my test predictions.
cues.zh: 也就是將 Y 的真實值和測試預測值串接。

cues.en: And I know there's a lot of code here as well as a lot of braces, brackets, and parentheses.
cues.zh: 我知道這裡程式碼很多，也用了許多大括號、中括號和小括號。

cues.en: So if you get an error somewhere, go ahead and check out our notebook and just run that directly.
cues.zh: 如果出錯，可以查看課程筆記本，直接執行其中的程式碼。

cues.en: And here what I'm going to do is also make sure that I'm joining these along axis equal to one, so along the columns.
cues.zh: 這裡也要確認使用 axis=1，也就是沿著欄的方向合併。

cues.en: After running that, you should be able to see your prediction data frame which is essentially looking like this.
cues.zh: 執行後就能看到預測資料框，大致長這樣。

cues.en: We have Test True Y, and here we get zero because we don't actually have a name for that.
cues.zh: 有 Test True Y，而另一欄顯示 0，因為還沒有指定名稱。

cues.en: So go ahead and say my columns are Test True Y and then my model predictions.
cues.zh: 所以把欄名設成 Test True Y 和 Model Predictions。

cues.en: So now when I take a look at my predicted data frame, I get this result.
cues.zh: 再查看預測資料框，就得到這個結果。

cues.en: So here I can directly see, based off my test set, what the true price value was and what my model predicted.
cues.zh: 這樣就能直接看到測試集的真實價格，以及模型預測的價格。

cues.en: Okay, so what I can do is lots of things now.
cues.zh: 好，現在可以做很多事。

cues.en: I can actually plot these against each other.
cues.zh: 我們可以把兩者畫在同一張圖上比較。

cues.en: So what I could do is say create a scatter plot based off this data in my prediction data frame.
cues.zh: 根據預測資料框中的資料建立散佈圖。

cues.en: And then I'll also do the following.
cues.zh: 然後再做以下設定。

cues.en: I'll say x is equal to Test True Y,
cues.zh: x 設成 Test True Y，

cues.en: and I'll plot it against these Model Predictions.
cues.zh: 與 Model Predictions 作圖比較。

cues.en: So run that and we see this result.
cues.zh: 執行後得到這個結果。

cues.en: So what does this actually mean?
cues.zh: 這代表什麼？

cues.en: Well, let's imagine that my predictions were a perfect match for the True Y prices.
cues.zh: 假設預測價格和 True Y 的真實價格完全一致。

cues.en: That means I would expect a perfect straight line here because if my price was 300, then my prediction should also be 300.
cues.zh: 那就應該形成一條完美直線，因為真實價格是 300 時，預測值也應該是 300。

cues.en: Now notice we actually are quite close to a very straight fitting line, which means this model is performing very well.
cues.zh: 注意，這裡的點其實非常接近一直線，表示模型表現很好。

cues.en: And we can also grab metrics to essentially show that, not just qualitatively through a plot, but quantitatively through the various regression methods
cues.zh: 我們也能取得評估指標，除了透過圖形定性觀察，還能使用各種迴歸評估方法定量衡量，

cues.en: that we talked about.
cues.zh: 就是之前談過的方法。

cues.en: Recall back, in the machine learning lectures, we had a whole discussion on regression evaluation.
cues.zh: 回想機器學習課程，我們曾完整討論迴歸評估。

cues.en: So we talked about mean absolute error, mean squared error, and then root mean squared error.
cues.zh: 包括平均絕對誤差、均方誤差和均方根誤差。

cues.en: So let's show you how you can actually grab those.
cues.zh: 現在示範如何取得它們。

cues.en: To do that I can say from sklearn.metrics import
cues.zh: 使用 from sklearn.metrics import，

cues.en: mean_absolute_error and mean_squared_error.
cues.zh: 匯入 mean_absolute_error 和 mean_squared_error。

cues.en: And if I want my mean_absolute_error, then I just need to, if I take a look at this, compare my y true to my y predicted.
cues.zh: 若要計算 mean_absolute_error，查看用法就知道，需要比較真實 y 和預測 y。

cues.en: And luckily I've already organized that for myself in this data frame where I have my Test True Y,
cues.zh: 幸好我已經把資料整理在這個資料框裡，有 Test True Y，

cues.en: and I also have my Model Predictions.
cues.zh: 也有 Model Predictions。

cues.en: So I run that and I get a mean absolute error of about four, which is something you should be getting.
cues.zh: 執行後得到約 4 的平均絕對誤差，你的結果應該也接近這個值。

cues.en: You should be getting somewhere around four for a mean absolute error.
cues.zh: 平均絕對誤差應該在 4 左右。

cues.en: So this means on average I'm about $4 off from my price point.
cues.zh: 這表示預測價格平均相差約 4 美元。

cues.en: Now the most common student question I get is how do I know if this is good or bad?
cues.zh: 學生最常問的是：怎麼知道這樣算好還是不好？

cues.en: Well, it really depends on your original data.
cues.zh: 這取決於原始資料。

cues.en: If you take a look at our original data frame, recall we have this price column, let's go ahead and call .describe on this.
cues.zh: 看一下原始資料框，還記得有 price 欄，對它呼叫 .describe。

cues.en: And we can see that the average price is around $500 with a minimum of 223 and a maximum of 774.
cues.zh: 可以看到平均價格約 500 美元，最低 223，最高 774。

cues.en: And our mean absolute error, that is on average how far off we are, we are on average off by $4.
cues.zh: 而平均絕對誤差，也就是平均相差多少，是 4 美元。

cues.en: So if I take a look at the mean price, that's less than 1%.
cues.zh: 相對於平均價格，這不到 1%。

cues.en: So that would mean that this is actually a pretty good mean absolute error.
cues.zh: 所以這樣的平均絕對誤差算是相當好。

cues.en: Something indicated again, by this plot right here that's almost a perfect straight line.
cues.zh: 這張幾乎呈一直線的圖也再次反映這點。

cues.en: So this indicates that our model is performing very well at predicting the price of, let's say, this gemstone based off these two features.
cues.zh: 這表示模型根據兩個特徵預測寶石價格時，表現很好。

cues.en: Now again, the mean absolute error doesn't mean anything without the context of the label you're trying to predict.
cues.zh: 再提醒一次，平均絕對誤差必須放在你所預測標籤的脈絡中解讀。

cues.en: If the average price was $1 and our mean absolute error was $4 that means we're off by 400%, and that's a very different story.
cues.zh: 如果平均價格是 1 美元，平均絕對誤差卻是 4 美元，那就是差了 400%，意義截然不同。

cues.en: So you always have to take into account the mean values as well as the actual distribution of your label when comparing it to your error, such as mean absolute error.
cues.zh: 所以比較平均絕對誤差之類的誤差時，必須考慮標籤的平均值與實際分布。

cues.en: And we can also calculate our mean squared error
cues.zh: 我們也可以計算均方誤差，

cues.en: by performing the exact same thing.
cues.zh: 做法完全相同。

cues.en: So I can say mean squared error, go ahead and copy and paste this, and notice it's 24.97, which is essentially the same thing we got
cues.zh: 改用 mean_squared_error，直接複製貼上，得到 24.97，基本上和先前得到的數值相同，

cues.en: at the very bottom here when we said model.evaluate on X_test versus y_test, which makes sense because the original loss for the model was mean squared error.
cues.zh: 也就是下方對 X_test 和 y_test 呼叫 model.evaluate 的結果，因為模型原先選定的損失就是均方誤差。

cues.en: So essentially what this model evaluate line does is exactly what this line does.
cues.zh: 因此這行 model.evaluate 做的事，和這行完全相同。

cues.en: It just calculates the mean squared error for whatever you pass in, either the test set or the training set.
cues.zh: 它會針對你傳入的測試集或訓練集計算均方誤差。

cues.en: And if we wanted to get the root mean squared error then all I would need to do is essentially take this square root of this, which is the same as taking something to the power of 0.5.
cues.zh: 如果想取得均方根誤差，只需要把這個值開平方根，也就是取 0.5 次方。

cues.en: You could also say np.sqrt if you've imported NumPy, and then we get back the root mean squared error, which is 4.99.
cues.zh: 如果已匯入 NumPy，也能用 np.sqrt，得到均方根誤差 4.99。

cues.en: So you can use the mean_absolute_error, mean_squared_error and root_mean_squared_error however you see fit to evaluate your model's performance.
cues.zh: 你可以依需要使用 mean_absolute_error、mean_squared_error 和 root_mean_squared_error 評估模型表現。

cues.en: And finally, I wanna go over two last things, which is predicting on brand new data.
cues.zh: 最後我還想介紹兩件事，首先是預測全新的資料。

cues.en: So let's imagine that we go out into the field and I pick out this gemstone from the ground and it has these features.
cues.zh: 假設我們到野外，從地上撿到一顆具有這些特徵的寶石。

cues.en: Let's say I pick out this new gemstone and pay attention to my dimensions here, I have double braces, so that it matches up with the original data.
cues.zh: 這裡建立新寶石資料，請注意維度，用兩層中括號來符合原始資料的形狀。

cues.en: And feature one is equal to 998 and feature two is equal to a thousand.
cues.zh: 特徵一是 998，特徵二是 1000。

cues.en: And these are just made up features.
cues.zh: 這些特徵都是虛構的。

cues.en: So I picked this new gem out of the ground and now I wanna ask my model, "What should I price this at?"
cues.zh: 我從地上撿到新寶石後，想問模型：「這顆應該定價多少？」

cues.en: Well, the one thing I have to remember is that my model is trained on the scaled features.
cues.zh: 必須記得，模型是用縮放後的特徵訓練的。

cues.en: So what I have to first do is take my original scaler and transform new_gem.
cues.zh: 所以要先用原來的 scaler，對 new_gem 呼叫 transform。

cues.en: So now I have the scaled version of these features.
cues.zh: 這樣就得到這些特徵縮放後的版本。

cues.en: So let's go ahead and set new_gem equal to the scaled version of new_gem.
cues.zh: 把 new_gem 設成縮放後的 new_gem。

cues.en: And now what I can do is simply take my model and predict the price of that new_gem, which in this case should be somewhere around $420.
cues.zh: 現在只需要讓模型預測 new_gem 的價格，這裡應該會在 420 美元左右。

cues.en: So that's how you would predict on a brand new set of data.
cues.zh: 這就是對全新資料進行預測的方式。

cues.en: Keep in mind that's the exact same process you just ran on your test data set since your test data set, according to the model, is essentially brand new data it's never seen before.
cues.zh: 這和剛才對測試集做的流程完全相同，因為對模型而言，測試集就是從未見過的全新資料。

cues.en: So the way you evaluate your test set is basically the exact same thing you would do for brand new data.
cues.zh: 所以評估測試集時，基本上就是在執行預測新資料的相同流程。

cues.en: And finally, if you're running a very complex model that took a lot of time to train, you wanna make sure that you save that model, and Keras makes it quite easy.
cues.zh: 最後，如果複雜模型花了很久才訓練完成，你會想把模型存起來，而 Keras 讓這件事很容易。

cues.en: We simply say from tensorflow.keras.models, import, load_model,
cues.zh: 只要用 from tensorflow.keras.models import load_model，

cues.en: and then I take my current existing model and I save it as a HDF5 file.
cues.zh: 再把現有模型儲存成 HDF5 檔案。

cues.en: So I can say some string, my_gem_model.h5, run that,
cues.zh: 可以指定檔名字串 my_gem_model.h5，然後執行。

cues.en: and now what I can do is use the load model command.
cues.zh: 接著就能使用 load_model 指令。

cues.en: So later on I can say, okay, I am in a new notebook and I wanna load up this model.
cues.zh: 例如之後開啟新筆記本，想載入這個模型。

cues.en: I simply run this import command of load model, and I say, later model is equal to load model.
cues.zh: 只要執行這個匯入 load_model 的指令，再讓 later_model 等於 load_model 的結果。

cues.en: And then I read in that model I saved, my_gem_model.h5.
cues.zh: 讀取先前儲存的 my_gem_model.h5。

cues.en: And then you may get some warning there based off the input shape.
cues.zh: 這裡可能會出現和輸入形狀有關的警告。

cues.en: You can totally ignore that warning, it's okay.
cues.zh: 這個警告可以忽略，沒有關係。

cues.en: But notice, now I can treat this later model just as I would any other model, and then predict on new gem just as I did before.
cues.zh: 現在就能像使用其他模型一樣使用 later_model，像剛才那樣預測 new_gem。

cues.en: And notice, we get back the exact same results.
cues.zh: 注意，得到的結果完全相同。

cues.en: So that's how you can both save a model and then load it later in a new file.
cues.zh: 這就是儲存模型，以及之後在新檔案裡載入的方法。

cues.en: Okay, so we went over the very basics of Keras.
cues.zh: 好，我們已介紹 Keras 最基本的用法。

cues.en: Now we did this on a fake generated data set.
cues.zh: 這次使用的是人工產生的資料集。

cues.en: Coming up next, let's focus on a much more realistic data set, and really focus on the full workflow, including exploratory data analysis and feature engineering, which is very crucial
cues.zh: 接下來將使用更真實的資料，著重完整流程，包括探索式資料分析和特徵工程，這對成為優秀的機器學習實務工作者，

cues.en: to becoming a good machine learning practitioner.
cues.zh: 非常重要。

cues.en: Thanks, and I'll see you at the next lecture.
cues.zh: 謝謝，下堂課見。
